# Matilda

> Matilda is a personal AI assistant that texts, emails, keeps your reminders and actually calls you. She lives at https://matilda-is-a-bot.app, and you sign in with GitHub.

Matilda answers in a chat on the web, over Telegram, iMessage and WhatsApp, and by email from your own address on matilda-is-a-bot.app. She rings you in the app when a reminder is due, calls again if you miss it, and calls to check in when something you talked about needs a follow-up. Each workspace has a lead (Matilda) and bots you add, each with its own role and model.

## What she does

- Reminders that recur, pause or stop on their own, by chat, text, email or a call
- Commands like /plan, /run, /research, /quiz and /study, typed with a slash in the chat
- Plans that run as step-by-step tasks, with a Try again button when a step fails
- Flash cards and quizzes with spaced review, quizzed by voice on a call
- Pages that keep themselves up to date: reports, memos and dashboards

## Pages

- [Home](https://matilda-is-a-bot.app/): what Matilda is
- [Sign in](https://matilda-is-a-bot.app/sign-in): sign in with GitHub
